svg.aria-label: claude-mv moving a folder: a restore point is taken, the folder is moved, and its Claude profile is re-keyed — the project dir renamed, session files rewritten, the config key and history entries updated — closing with a green done line and a tally

text.tspan: — 1 project dir · 3 session files · 1 config key · 4 history entries
`claude --resume` in the new location will find the old sessions (restore point cleaned up)
